name: two-neighbours-by-hand
why: The case worked on docs/concepts/steering.md. A is 2 away inside the separation radius of 4 and pushes at half strength: (-0.5, 0) times 20 is (-10, 0). Headings (0, 1) and (1, 0) add to the diagonal: wanted (7.071, 7.071), minus the velocity (5, 0). The centre is (1, 3): wanted (3.162, 9.487), minus (5, 0). Weighted 1.5, 1, 1 they add to (-14.767, 16.558), longer than 20, so the flock's force is clamped to (-13.312, 14.926).
